reviewerRole: Read-only independent implementation review. No code, resource, or test file was changed.

scope.comparison: Published 0.1.10 preview source snapshot at acts-entities-work/candidate/apps/ios/Sources, paired with this workspace release note.
focus: candidate map policy and map notes
scope.method: Compared current and baseline Swift source, read ROM/LEV runtime JSON resources and tests, then traced gating and UI call paths statically. No app launch or network access.

baseline.qualification: This workspace has no Git metadata and no signed 0.1.10 binary/source revision link. Comparison is to the published-preview source snapshot and release note; exact binary reproducibility is unverified.

codeChangeSummary.EntityProfiles.swift: Adds relationVerified and Wikipedia knownBy, contextProfiles, resolved context notes and a gated resolved Wikipedia property. Related-section links require an explicit verified relation and note.
codeChangeSummary.BundledEntityIndex.swift: Adds per-book profile and map-policy caches; ACT/ROM/LEV use their bundled occurrence tables. Existing Theographic index remains shared. Candidate coordinates are returned only after a matching policy and allowFrom gate.
codeChangeSummary.OfflineEntityPane.swift: Routes ACT/ROM/LEV through the WEB-verified disclosure, passes policy reason to candidate maps, and renders resolved context notes and gated Wikipedia links.

findings.basis: Resolved nameJa always chooses names with knownBy <= passage.end; this expression ignores includeFuture. In current ROM data person:adam_78 is knownBy ROM 5:12, base label "one man", and has a name alias "Adam" gated at ROM 5:14. Toggling future material on at ROM 5:12 reveals the 5:14 fact but resolved.nameJa remains "one man" in both states. This is a mismatch with the toggle text promising later appearances and supplementary information.
findings.reproduction: Compare lookup(ROM 5:12, person, includeFuture:false) and includeFuture:true. The latter adds the 5:14 fact, while nameJa is unchanged.
findings.recommendation: When includeFuture is true, allow the later EntityProfileName alias to be selected, or narrow the UI toggle description to references/facts only; add a ROM 5:12/5:14 regression test.

findings.basis: A single actor owns the shared index plus per-book catalog and map-policy dictionaries. Profile resources are named separately by book. The alternating ACT -> ROM -> LEV -> ACT unit test checks same-ID profiles and source citations stay book-specific.

Default resolution rejects a profile before knownBy, gates facts and source objects at passage.end, gates WikipediaReadingLink.knownBy, and filters display aliases by knownBy. includeFuture expands facts, source metadata, Wikipedia links and same-book references. The Romans/Leviticus Holy Spirit test checks 5:5 hides later facts and respects source/wiki gates. Exception: the display alias toggle gap is separately reported as RUNTIME-NAME-GATE-001.

Context profiles are selected by knownBy and passage overlap; a passage wholly inside a variant selects it. A wider range keeps the base and renders a context note. Tests cover Romans 9:6, 9:13 and 9:4-13; Leviticus 1:2, 26:42 and 1:2-26:42.

Runtime policy decodes allowFrom as Verse?; packaged ROM/LEV policies use the matching chapter/verse object. A legacy coordinate is taken only from the same stable ID in the original index and only when allowCandidateMap is true and allowFrom <= passage.end. The profile coordinate remains separate. policy.reasonJa is carried to candidateMapNote and displayed by the candidate-map view. Current ROM Cenchreae policy allows the candidate beginning at ROM 16:1 with profile coordinate null.

An identity-unverified URL is allowed only when kind is related-section, relationVerified is true, a note is present, and host/scheme/path checks pass. UI labels it as a related section, shows the identity note, and keeps WEB citations in a separate source category. No code-path conflation with identity proof found.
